mapper.select: SELECT SITE_INFO.SITE_SEQ , SITE_INFO.SITE_CD , SITE_INFO.SITE_TP , ( SELECT CD_NM FROM CMN_CD_INFO_TBL WHERE 1 = 1 AND GRP_CD = 'CMN_SITE_INFO_001' AND CD = SITE_INFO.SITE_TP ) AS SITE_TP_NM , SITE_INFO.USE_YN , SITE_INFO.SITE_NM , SITE_INFO.SITE_BSC_URI , SITE_INFO.SITE_DESC , TO_CHAR(SITE_INFO.RGST_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.MS') AS RGST_DT , SITE_INFO.RGST_SEQ , ( SELECT ADM_NM FROM SYS_ADM_INFO_TBL WHERE 1 = 1 AND ADM_SEQ = SITE_INFO.RGST_SEQ ) AS RGST_NM , TO_CHAR(SITE_INFO.UPDT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.MS') AS UPDT_DT , SITE_INFO.UPDT_SEQ , ( SELECT ADM_NM FROM SYS_ADM_INFO_TBL WHERE 1 = 1 AND ADM_SEQ = SITE_INFO.UPDT_SEQ ) AS UPDT_NM FROM CMN_SITE_INFO_TBL SITE_INFO WHERE 1 = 1 AND (((#{useYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR (#{useYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '')) OR (SITE_INFO.USE_YN = #{useYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR})) AND (((#{siteTp, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR (#{siteTp, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '')) OR (SITE_INFO.SITE_TP = #{siteTp, jdbcType=VARCHAR})) AND (((#{siteNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR (#{siteNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '')) OR (SITE_INFO.SITE_NM LIKE '%' || #{siteNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%'))

SELECT SITE_INFO.SITE_SEQ , SITE_INFO.SITE_CD , SITE_INFO.SITE_TP , ( SELECT CD_NM FROM CMN_CD_INFO_TBL WHERE 1 = 1 AND GRP_CD = 'CMN_SITE_INFO_001' AND CD = SITE_INFO.SITE_TP ) AS SITE_TP_NM , SITE_INFO.USE_YN , SITE_INFO.SITE_NM , SITE_INFO.SITE_BSC_URI , SITE_INFO.SITE_DESC , TO_CHAR(SITE_INFO.RGST_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.MS') AS RGST_DT , SITE_INFO.RGST_SEQ , ( SELECT ADM_NM FROM SYS_ADM_INFO_TBL WHERE 1 = 1 AND ADM_SEQ = SITE_INFO.RGST_SEQ ) AS RGST_NM , TO_CHAR(SITE_INFO.UPDT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.MS') AS UPDT_DT , SITE_INFO.UPDT_SEQ , ( SELECT ADM_NM FROM SYS_ADM_INFO_TBL WHERE 1 = 1 AND ADM_SEQ = SITE_INFO.UPDT_SEQ ) AS UPDT_NM FROM CMN_SITE_INFO_TBL SITE_INFO WHERE 1 = 1 AND (((#{siteSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC} IS NULL) OR (#{siteSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC} = 0)) OR (SITE_INFO.SITE_SEQ = #{siteSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC})) AND (((#{siteCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR (#{siteCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '')) OR (SITE_INFO.SITE_CD = #{siteCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}))
